name: MetaSea atomic open/redeem distributor depletion
summary: MetaSea Round implementation 0x13dde273 (activated 4.4 h before the attack) added openV6/redeemPosition. redeemPosition has no elapsed-time gate: a position opened with 3,000 USDT and redeemed in the same transaction takes a SEA fee quoted at 200 USDT, then pays back 2,000 USDT plus SEA quoted at the full 3,000 USDT deposit, both funded from the SEA distributor, so each atomic open/redeem cycle extracts value. Five senders completed 182 redemptions in 16 transactions and sold the SEA into the SEA/USDT pair.

loss.notes: USDT net-drained from the SEA/USDT pair by the sale of distributor-paid SEA across 16 redemption and 37 disposal transactions, plus the unsold SEA residual valued at post-campaign pair spot. Flash-loan premiums are not deducted; SEA flows inside the campaign are not valued a second time.

ageReset.description: upgradeToAndCall selected implementation 0x13dde273, which introduced openV6/redeemPosition; the only later admin change (setPair, slot 5) is not read by the exploit.

limitations: Implementation source is unverified; the defect is attributed from the call trace, router quotes and bytecode selectors.

sources.note: Anchor and root cause (Arbitrum, ARBITRUM_RPC_URL). cast logs on Round proxy 0xa70f31c06f921019237fc00b1417217dae5c37c5, blocks 463777597..463844859: Open topic 0x5a3815aac78c63e8e8e94e1bf2d7294adb131f4320dc4172da5d7594eb7bb089 = 183 logs, Redeem topic 0x8e13eae94523af1c4e18788b451cbcf1a6bc9c1ad9f96c3bf1601670e3455988 = 182 logs, both in 16 txs, first at 463840942 tx 1 (log 39 / log 64) = 0xcbcbcfe3, last at 463841129 tx 0x6287b348; per-tx redeem counts 12x14,10,4; zero Redeem logs from 463844859 to latest. Selectors openV6 0x987217bc and redeemPosition 0xf046d966 and both event topics occur in the runtime of implementation 0x13dde273b66323686bfb96cce5a2a7190b40b264 only; none of the 20 earlier implementations selected by Round Upgraded events contains any of them, so no earlier exercise is possible. debug_traceTransaction callTracer on 0xcbcbcfe3, first cycle: attacker contract 0xa07b22838464ce55adefc5f25448df52993274dc calls openV6(3000e6,0); Round pulls 3000 USDT, router-swaps 1000 USDT -> 392699.807960 SEA sent to 0x...dead and 2000 USDT -> 775170.428387 SEA sent to distributor 0x5210525fbf63e55eca1ade9ff98a3ef80af9220e. Same tx, redeemPosition(): Round calls router getAmountsOut(3000e6,[USDT,SEA]) -> 1137840.243436 SEA and getAmountsOut(200e6) -> 76777.314675 SEA; transferFrom 76777.314675 SEA from the caller; distributor fbec6d5e(Round, 906246.648132 SEA) funds swapTokensForExactTokens to 2000 USDT, paid to caller; distributor fbec6d5e(Round, 1137840.243436 SEA) is forwarded to caller. Net per cycle to caller: -3000 USDT -76777 SEA, +2000 USDT +1137840 SEA with zero elapsed time. Distributor fbec6d5e is access-controlled: eth_call at block 463840941 from 0x...beef reverts 'Not authorized', from the Round succeeds, so the SEA release is decided by the Round implementation; the distributor (impl 0xd4114ed07febc57113158d53266f6ecb71447fbf, last Upgraded 449555311:12:47) is a funding source, not the defect. Implementation and distributor sources are unverified; the root cause is established from the trace and bytecode selectors, consistent with source-62.

Critical state: Etherscan txlist of the proxy 463777597..463840942 shows only two admin txs, the upgrade and setPair(0xeeb9c6b7) tx 0xec584595 at 463777611 (slot 5: 0x...dd1f86e76c3e57fa836d68cc0d7d81184269543b, a codeless address, -> 0x...eeb9c6b7); all other senders call user methods. prestateTracer on 0xcbcbcfe3 lists the 27 Round slots the exploit accessed; slot 5 is not among them (the Round swaps via router 0x258bdfa1 read from slot 4), so setPair is not causal and the age resets at the upgrade: 1779038362 - 1779022466 = 15896 s.

limitations: Implementation and distributor sources are unverified; root cause rests on trace evidence.
